# En Peyar - Tamil Startup Name Generator

> A specialized AI naming engine designed to help founders discover culturally rich, modern brand names inspired by Tamil linguistic heritage.

## Overview
En Peyar (meaning "My Name" in Tamil) is a web application that generates brand names using a multi-stage AI pipeline. It connects modern startup visions with ancient Tamil etymology, ensuring that brands are both globally pronounceable and culturally meaningful.

## Core Features
- **AI Name Generation:** Uses Groq's Llama models to generate startup-ready names.
- **Tamil Root Discovery:** Maps generated names back to their linguistic roots.
- **Brand Toolkit:** Provides taglines, pronunciation audio (gTTS), domain availability checks, and Midjourney logo prompts.
- **Offline PWA:** Fully installable progressive web app.

## Tech Stack
- **Backend:** Python, Flask, Flask-Limiter, Flask-Talisman, gTTS
- **Frontend:** HTML, JavaScript (Vanilla ES6), TailwindCSS, DOMPurify
- **Infrastructure:** Vercel (Hosting), GitHub Actions (CI)
- **AI Models:** Llama-3 (Groq API)

## Documentation & Repository
- **GitHub Repo:** https://github.com/MKishoreDev/en-peyar
- **License:** MIT
- **Contribution Guide:** Please refer to the `CONTRIBUTING.md` in the repository for setup instructions.

## Security Context
The application uses strict Content Security Policy (CSP) headers without `unsafe-inline` or `unsafe-eval`. All dynamic user inputs and API responses are sanitized using DOMPurify before being injected into the DOM via JavaScript event delegation.
